probes.check: am_probe_jolt_serialization(): am_jolt_rebuild_key() names Jolt's version, the composition's variant (AUTOMAP_VARIANT_JOLT) and JPH_VERSION_ID.

seeded_violation.description: Key Jolt's data by its version alone.

adaptation_notes: am_jolt_rebuild_key() is the key for anything Jolt writes that outlives a run: PhysicsSystem::SaveState snapshots and shapes and settings saved with SaveBinaryState. JPH_VERSION_ID packs Jolt's version with its ABI-affecting defines (double precision, determinism, object layer bits), so a double-precision build never reads single-precision data.
